correctness.rationale: Direct absolutely convergent Gaussian integration yields a nowhere-zero prefactor and a quadratic Q_r(2 cosh z). Exact discriminant factorization gives precisely r=2 and r=1+sqrt(5). Q_r(2)>0 and Q_r(-2)>=5/16 uniformly, excluding other preimage collisions. Continuity and real/complex root geometry classify all zeros. A reciprocal quartic with nonzero leading and constant terms proves exactly four zeros per period with total multiplicity. Critical points are two double zeros each because the cosh map is locally invertible at their y-values. CHECK.py independently tests normalization, elementary identities, representative roots and nonzero second derivatives. Sample checks are not the proof.

value.rationale: The coherent five-frequency Dirichlet comb is the next natural symmetric multi-tone interferer beyond two tones. Its Gaussian STFT undergoes two different sharp topological reorganizations of all exact cancellation zeros, with closed algebraic gap values and collision coordinates. Phase singularity locations provide reproducible benchmarks for time-frequency diagnostics, and the theorem classifies the entire positive-parameter family rather than a contrived numerical subcase. It does not claim independent publication certification.
